MANUFACTURING

Precision made.
Clearly proven.

From incoming material to final testing, every step is designed for consistency and traceability.

Control starts with material

Critical pressure-containing parts use traceable materials, verified for chemical composition and mechanical properties before machining. CNC equipment and dedicated fixtures control the fit of balls, seats, and seals.

Production organized for project delivery

Each valve has an individual manufacturing record. Process, inspection, test, and packing stages are linked to project documents for audits, acceptance, and lifecycle support.
